steps: 1. Confirm the newest game log contains `[cwv:LOAD] v0.1.570-dev`.
2. Equip one Old Musket in the primary weapon slot and a normal weapon in the secondary slot; confirm it starts with one chambered round and 10 reserve rounds.
3. Fire and reload once, switch weapons and back, and confirm the reserve remains 9 without free ammunition.
4. In a fresh loadout, equip an Old Musket in both weapon slots; confirm separate one-round chambers and a shared 20-round reserve.
5. Fire and reload each Musket once; confirm both report the same remaining reserve of 18.
6. Spend several rounds and collect one normal ammunition pickup; confirm the shared reserve changes once.
7. Replace one Old Musket with a normal weapon; confirm the remaining Musket has a 10-round reserve cap.
assertions: One Old Musket owns a 10-round reserve; two Old Muskets owned by the same player share 20 reserve while retaining separate chambers. Stance changes, weapon switches, pickups, and slot replacement neither duplicate nor lose ammunition, and `issue932_primary_slot_musket_ammo_pool_contract` passes.
Primary musket plus handgun: chamber 1 and reserve 10; both slots: shared reserve 20; fire and reload each gives 18; one ammo pickup changes reserve once.
